reviewer: Codex (AI-assisted engineering scope review; not a human reviewer)
review_basis: Manual question-by-question engineering review against frozen identities and implemented tool contracts, including negated/background mentions. No model outputs were used; application constraint behavior was not treated as the reference standard.

case_notes.fresh-symbol-id-symbol: Exact case-insensitive TP53 symbol maps to UniProtKB:P04637. The saved MONDO:0005008 cohort and candidate interactions are explicit.
case_notes.fresh-symbol-id-identifier: UniProtKB:P04637 is a complete catalogue identifier. The requested source disease, candidate view and interactions match the reference.
case_notes.fresh-alias-boundary-listed: APC is an exact listed symbol for UniProtKB:P25054. One candidate interaction query can fulfill the request.
case_notes.fresh-alias-boundary-unlisted: The exact catalogue has TP53 but no p53 symbol or identifier alias. The question explicitly forbids alias guessing; abstention is appropriate.
case_notes.fresh-view-negation-include: The requested target is TP53 and unreviewed candidates are explicitly included, so the candidate interaction view is appropriate.
case_notes.fresh-view-negation-exclude: The question excludes unreviewed candidates and explicitly selects locally accepted evidence. An empty accepted result remains a valid query.
case_notes.fresh-double-negation-retain: The second clause explicitly includes the candidate view, agreeing with do not exclude. APC interactions in the saved cohort are supported.
case_notes.fresh-double-negation-remove: The second sentence explicitly requests only locally accepted APC interactions. Candidate/provisional assertions must not be added.
case_notes.fresh-relation-negation-pathways: Shared pathways are positively requested and interactions explicitly excluded. One shared_pathways relation fulfills the request; mentioning an exclusion does not request it.
case_notes.fresh-relation-negation-interactions: Interactions are positively requested and shared pathways explicitly excluded. One interactions relation fulfills the request.
case_notes.fresh-relation-conjunction-both: PIK3CA maps to UniProtKB:P42336. The protein-neighborhood tool supports both relation types together within a single query.
case_notes.fresh-relation-conjunction-single: PIK3CA is the sole anchor and interactions the sole requested relation. Do not add shared pathways.
case_notes.fresh-profile-id-exact: The complete profile ID 79 is present. DOID:9256, panitumumab membership and candidate view are supported; complete treatment sets are retained.
case_notes.fresh-profile-id-unknown: Profile 7999999 is not present and is not identifier 79. The question forbids shorter-ID substitution; abstention preserves identity.
case_notes.fresh-or-profile-upper: KRAS G12 OR KRAS G13 is the complete catalogue profile 5162. Its OR must remain whole; cetuximab membership with full treatment sets is supported.
case_notes.fresh-or-profile-lower: Case-insensitive complete-name matching yields profile 5162 without splitting its disjunction. Unreviewed records select candidates; cetuximab is the requested therapy.
case_notes.fresh-compound-completion-known: KRAS G12D is complete profile 79. Candidate CIViC records containing cetuximab in the exact source disease are within the contract.
case_notes.fresh-compound-completion-unknown: NOT KRAS G12D is not a catalogue profile. Removing NOT would change the requested complete identity; abstention is required.
case_notes.fresh-lowercase-compound-and: The complete AND profile includes UNKNOWN_X999 and is absent. Lowercase wording does not authorize dropping a component or querying contained profile 79.
case_notes.fresh-lowercase-compound-or: The complete OR profile includes UNKNOWN_X999 and is absent. Lowercase wording does not authorize replacing the disjunction with contained profile 79.
case_notes.fresh-therapy-background-cetuximab: Cetuximab is explicitly the requested target; panitumumab is explicitly background. The question retains combinations, so no unsupported exclusion of combination records is required.
case_notes.fresh-therapy-background-panitumumab: Panitumumab is explicitly the requested target; cetuximab is explicitly background. Full treatment sets, including combinations, must remain intact.
case_notes.fresh-all-profile-negation-all: All molecular profiles are affirmatively requested and the tool supports all with panitumumab membership. Candidate view and full treatment sets are explicit.
case_notes.fresh-all-profile-negation-single: The all-profiles request is negated; only KRAS G12D (profile 79) is requested. One candidate panitumumab query fulfills this without broadening to all.
case_notes.fresh-source-disease-supported: DOID:9256 is exactly the fixed CIViC source disease. Profile 79 and cetuximab membership are supported.
case_notes.fresh-source-disease-subtype: The request fixes MONDO:0005008 and explicitly prohibits broader transfer. The CIViC tool only serves DOID:9256; abstention preserves the disease boundary.
case_notes.fresh-direction-scope-retain: Sensitivity/resistance are named as annotations to inspect, not an exclusive filter; the question explicitly retains all directions and full treatment sets. One unfiltered candidate query is appropriate.
case_notes.fresh-direction-scope-filter: Only sensitivity is an explicit significance filter. The current tool does not implement it; returning all directions would not satisfy the request.
case_notes.fresh-tool-conjunction-single: TP53 is a single listed anchor and candidate interactions a single supported protein-neighborhood query in the selected cohort.
case_notes.fresh-tool-conjunction-multiple: The question requires a protein-neighborhood answer and a molecular-profile therapy answer. One allowed query cannot fulfill both, so abstention is appropriate.
case_notes.fresh-intent-negation-inspection: The drug-recommendation action is explicitly negated. The positive request is research inspection of exact-profile CIViC records with complete treatment sets, which is supported.
case_notes.fresh-intent-negation-recommendation: The positive request is to recommend a drug for a patient. This is outside the read-only evidence-inspection contract; abstention is appropriate.
